The Budget module is used to manage and track financial budgets within the library. It includes fields for defining the budget period, providing a description, setting the total amount, and managing the budget's status and restrictions.

Fields and Descriptions

Start Date:

  • Description: The date when the budget period begins.
  • Usage: Enter the start date of the budget period in the format dd/mm/yyyy.
  • Example: "01/01/2024"
  • Validation: Must be a valid date format (dd/mm/yyyy).

End Date:

  • Description: The date when the budget period ends.
  • Usage: Enter the end date of the budget period in the format dd/mm/yyyy.
  • Example: "31/12/2024"
  • Validation: Must be a valid date format (dd/mm/yyyy).

Description:

  • Description: A detailed description of the budget, including its purpose and any relevant details.
  • Usage: Provide a comprehensive description of the budget.
  • Example: "Annual budget for new book acquisitions and library events."
  • Validation: Must be a valid string.

Total Amount:

  • Description: The total amount allocated for the budget period.
  • Usage: Enter the total monetary amount for the budget.
  • Example: "10000.00"
  • Validation: Must be a positive monetary value.

Make Budget Active:

  • Description: Indicates whether the budget should be activated and available for use.
  • Usage: Select "Yes" to activate the budget or "No" to keep it inactive.
  • Example: "Yes"
  • Validation: Must be a boolean value (Yes or No).

Lock Budget:

  • Description: Indicates whether the budget should be locked to prevent further modifications.
  • Usage: Select "Yes" to lock the budget or "No" to keep it editable.
  • Example: "No"
  • Validation: Must be a boolean value (Yes or No).
